When a mysterious figure from Judith's past emerges and a hit goes badly wrong, they're forced to go on the run together.

episodes.title: The Yellow Wood

The Albanians close in.

episodes.title: The Count of Monte Carlo
episodes.overview: An unlikely trio sets off for Monte Carlo to track down David's missing bribe money. Judith is forced to adopt an old cover, Debbie comes up with a very risky plan and neither of them know if they can trust Billy Donovan. Sam disappoints Queenie. Mrs. Williams is visited by a former colleague.

episodes.title: Moonlight on the Bosphorus
episodes.overview: With Judith in life-threatening peril, Debbie and Billy must decide what to do next. A lifeline from Sam provides Judith with terrifying information, and secrets about her past are revealed. Queenie confronts The Director, Jacques offers Debbie a deal, and Sam and Queenie take matters into their own hands and embark on a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: The Geneva Convention
episodes.overview: All roads converge in Geneva as everyone closes in on the stolen money. Judith discovers some unexpected guests, Interpol and the Albanians make their move, and romance blossoms. When the plan goes sideways, Judith and Debbie find themselves in mortal danger.

episodes.title: The Song of Deborah
episodes.overview: Back in London, Judith and Debbie's friendship seems beyond repair. Queenie learns a shocking truth, Sam deals with the fallout of his actions, and the Director takes Judith back into the fold. As the final piece of Ana's plan falls into place, Debbie and Judith hurtle towards a spectacular season finale.
